title: UX26 preflight: prepare stage-change and same-page recovery states for F14/F15
body:
## Outcome
Make the context-change and named-failure transitions in T14/T15 reproducible without replacing them with a different task.

## Delivery
Status: Mostly delivered — **one item remains**: commit the facilitator-only same-page phase controller (or an equivalent documented procedure) so the T14/T15 transitions can be reproduced from the repository. Stage routes and the answer-context display shipped in #47 (`9ae3e03`). Runtime evidence for all three T15 modes and T14 is in #48 (`2bcf5d8`). Unclaimed.
Previous status (superseded 8 November 2026): Backlog — readiness remediation, not dispatched
Priority: P0 for the affected #26 variants
Evidence: source-inspected preflight at `d3f54e887fb946bccf399f142791ed87e6be1b76`, independently checked by a fresh Codex verifier.
Run: `ux26-20261106`, resumed 7 November 2026.
Severity: high readiness impact; no actor or browser-observed failure is claimed.

## Reproduction and mismatch
- F14/F15 require an existing idea-stage response, a prototype-stage edit and observable old/new context or route behavior (`research/synthetic-ux/facilitator/evaluator-guide.md:30–31`).
- `apps/web/src/components/Journey.tsx:306` explicitly says fixture answers do not change by stage. Captured result context is not rendered with the earlier answer; the stale label at 347–353 names only the previous question/time.
- `apps/web/e2e/serve.mjs:17–22` fixes a fault at process startup. Navigating to another fault origin starts a fresh page and loses the existing result.
- The e2e stale-answer test at `journey.spec.ts:193–204` aborts the browser route. That is a separate transport-failure test, not a named vector/budget API fault transition.

## Acceptance
- Define a reviewed stage-focused fixture or explicitly version the task scope. Preserve actor wording and evaluation integrity.
- Seed the prior state through setup without giving actors expected outcomes or a click script.
- Configure a facilitator-only, same-origin healthy → named fault → recovery schedule that preserves the mounted page. A local API process restart/control may be used if demonstrated; do not expose fault controls through browser parameters, headers or public endpoints.
- Record each T15 variant separately. Graph degradation is a successful passage-only response, not interchangeable with vector timeout or budget errors.
- Verify draft/context and old/new answer labelling through the browser; unit/API tests alone do not establish this.
- T14 additionally remains blocked on actual 200% browser zoom evidence under #9. Viewport resizing is not a substitute.

[Exact UI source](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/blob/d3f54e887fb946bccf399f142791ed87e6be1b76/apps/web/src/components/Journey.tsx).
Refs #26 and #9. No product-fix dispatch or #27 completion is implied.

## Reconciliation against merged #47–#49 — 8 November 2026
By Claude (`claude-reconcile-20261108`) on Nissan's instruction. Verified on `main` at `0a7d9a6` from a fresh clone ([evidence](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/issues/23#issuecomment-6714202965); builder-run, not independent). Nothing was rebuilt.

| Acceptance | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Reviewed stage-focused fixture | Done (#47): `stage_variants` for Idea and Prototype, chosen only from structured `context.stage`. Other stages get an explicit `not_in_evidence` condition. Regressions in `scenarios.spec.ts` and e2e |
| Prior state seeded through setup, with no click script for actors | Done in the 7 November follow-up (#48 `followup/`) |
| Facilitator-only same-origin healthy → named fault → recovery, page kept mounted | **Shown, but not reproducible from the repository.** `followup/METHOD-NOTES.md`: a "private facilitator Unix socket 0600 switches/restarts API only at fixed port/key, web/page stays mounted". `server-phases.jsonl` and `recovery.jsonl` record the phases. The controller itself was never committed; `apps/web/e2e/serve.mjs` still fixes the fault at process start. **Remaining:** commit a facilitator-only controller (no browser parameter, header or public endpoint) or a documented procedure, and test it |
| Each T15 variant recorded separately | Done: vector 504→200, budget 429→200 (not a real budget reset), graph 200 passage-only → healthy 200 (#48) |
| Draft, context and old/new labelling checked in a browser | Done in the follow-up actors. #47 added e2e regressions for the answer-context line and for no stale label while a question loads |
| T14 actual 200% zoom | Scoped evidence (fresh light-theme actor at zoom 2, primed dark check) in #48. Wider zoom and screen reader → #9 |
